[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.List

def implementation (arr: List Int) : List String :=
  let filtered := arr.filter (· ∈ [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9])
  let sorted := filtered.reverse
  let indexed := List.map (fun x => digits[x-1]) sorted
  indexed

where digits : List String := ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]

[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma list_filter_mem
(l: List α)
(a: α)
(p: α → Prop)
(h_mem: a ∈ l)
(h_p: p a)
: p a ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ l → p x)
:=
⟨h_p, λ x hx, h_p x hx⟩

lemma list_map_idxOf
(l: List α)
(p: α → β)
(q: β → α)
(h: ∀ x, q (p x) = x)
(x: α)
(h_mem: x ∈ l)
: q (p x) ∈ l
:=
h_mem

lemma list_idxOf_digits_mem
(x: Nat)
(h_mem: 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9)
: digits[x-1]! ∈ digits
:=
begin
  have h_in_bounds: 0 ≤ x-1 ∧ x-1 < 8 := by
    have h1 := Nat.sub_le_of_le_add h_mem.left h_mem.right
    have h2 := Nat.sub_add_cancel h_mem.left
    linarith [h1, h2]
  simp [h_in_bounds]
end

lemma list_map_sort
(l: List α)
(p: α → β)
(q: β → α)
(h: ∀ x y, x ≤ y → p x ≤ p y)
: List.Sorted α.le (List.map p l) → List.Sorted α.le (List.map p l.reverse)
:=
begin
  intro h_sorted
  simp [h_sorted]
  intros x y h_x_y
  simp [h_x_y]
end

lemma list_map_idxOf_sorted
(l: List α)
(p: α → β)
(q: β → α)
(h: ∀ x y, x ≤ y → p x ≤ p y)
(x y: α)
(h_mem: x ∈ l ∧ y ∈ l)
(h_le: x ≤ y)
: (List.idxOf (q (p x)) (List.map p l) + 1) ≤ (List.idxOf (q (p y)) (List.map p l) + 1)
:=
begin
  have h_p: p x ≤ p y := by
    linarith [h_le, h]
  simp [h_p, h_le, h_mem, h]
end

[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation arr
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_filter_mem := arr.filter_mem arr
have h_sorted := by
  simp [List.Sorted.def, List.reverse.def, List.map, List.sorted]
  intros x y h_x_y
  simp [h_x_y]
  apply h
  linarith
simp [List.Sorted.def, List.reverse.def, List.map, List.sorted]
have h_mem_digits := by
  simp [h_filter_mem, h_sorted, h_mem_digits]
  simp [List.mem_filter, h_mem_digits]
  simp [List.mem_map, h_mem_digits]
